notes: Visual coordinates and tactical arrows are assistant-reviewed short editorial annotations in source pixels.
Official data provides the shot fact, not a frame-by-frame player path.
This library enables reuse but does not certify an Agent, RL model, web interface or cloud deployment executed it.
Existing frame caches require source binding checks before reuse; do not use old Flagg/Amen cached frames.
Full encoded playback and media validation are separate from offline tests.
